detailed_description: Wave Generator creates static SVG wave dividers directly in the browser. Adjust the wave height, frequency, amplitude, layer count, color, and top or bottom position, then preview the generated SVG before copying or downloading it. The tool is built for section separators, simple header or footer shapes, and reusable SVG snippets in web layouts. It does not create animations or manage responsive breakpoints for you.
usage_steps: Set the wave height in pixels.
Adjust frequency and amplitude until the curve has the shape you need.
Choose one to four layers and pick a fill color.
Select whether the wave should sit at the top or bottom of the SVG.
Review the preview, then copy or download the SVG code.
usage_examples: Create a static wave divider between two page sections.
Generate a simple SVG header or footer shape for a landing page.
Build a multi-layer decorative wave for a prototype.
Copy an SVG snippet into a design system or component demo.

faqs.question: Can I download the wave?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the download button to save the current SVG as wave.svg.

faqs.question: Does it generate animated waves?
faqs.answer: No. The current tool generates static SVG markup. Add animation separately in your own CSS or JavaScript if needed.

faqs.question: Which parts of the wave can I customize?
faqs.answer: You can adjust height, frequency, amplitude, layer count, color, and whether the wave is aligned to the top or bottom.

faqs.question: What should I check before using the Wave Generator output?
faqs.answer: Review the generated output, available options, and target context before publishing, deploying, or sharing it.

faqs.question: Can I edit the result after generating it?
faqs.answer: Yes. Adjust the input values or available options, generate the result again, and then copy, export, or reuse the updated output in your workflow when the page provides those actions.
